message:
Per #4127: apply review notes for comment sanitization

## Summary
Per the follow-up notes on #4127 and the LGTM thread from the content pipeline review, this PR applies the agreed cleanup to comment HTML post-processing.

The earlier review decision was to keep `Feedback` aligned with the framework sanitizer defaults rather than carrying a model-specific tag override for comments. This change is just the mechanical implementation of that approved direction:

- remove the `Feedback.allowed_tags` helper
- let `html_postprocess` call the sanitizer with its default safelist behavior
- drop the now-redundant spec that asserted a custom image-tag exclusion policy

## Context
This is not intended to reopen the sanitizer-policy discussion. That was already covered in #4127 / the review thread, where the conclusion was that comment rendering should rely on the shared sanitization path instead of maintaining a separate allowed-tags list in the model.

This PR simply brings the code in line with those review notes and reduces component-specific behavior in `Feedback`.

## Why this follow-up
The current override adds extra policy surface area in a low-level model hook and diverges from the common sanitizer configuration. Applying the previously approved review note here keeps behavior centralized and avoids carrying bespoke tag handling in `Feedback`.

## Testing
- updated model specs to reflect removal of the special-case tag assertion
- existing comment rendering/spec coverage continues to exercise HTML post-processing paths
